body: > ℹ️ No critical issues — one rough edge inline. **Reviewed changes** Reviewed the full diff of the recording detail page relayout (one commit, 14 files). - **Title row** — `← Library`, `RecordingTitle` and the small `MasterTag` now share the top row. The h1's `overflow: hidden` lets it shrink and ellipsize inside the `flex: 1; min-width: 0` wrapper. - **Details block** — the metadata line gains the probed resolution and an `N copies` count. The master note hides while the new "Saved to your Library" notice is showing. - **`DestinationsPanel`** — replaces `WhereIsThisGoingStrip`. It shows one card per `DESTINATION_IDS` entry with a `planCopy` size estimate, and its "Not now" brings back the "Export a copy" action. - **`MasterCopiesPanel`** — rewritten as a two-column grid with an "Open in Export →" header, a `W × H · size` facts line, a progress bar and a Drag button. The Drag button uses the same `startFileDrag` pattern as `export-status-cards.tsx`. The empty state is gone; the page renders the panel only when `hasCopies`. - **Probe and banner** — `useSourceProbe` now runs for every local recording. `HeavyToSendBanner` shows whenever the destinations panel doesn't. - **i18n / docs** — removed the `where*`, `copiesEmpty` and `copyProgress*` keys (no remaining references), added the new keys in `en` and `es`, and updated the backlog docs. The PR description says "Seven destinations", but `DESTINATION_IDS` and the backlog doc both list six. The code and docs agree with each other, so only the description needs fixing.   ｜ [Fix all ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog-v2/4?action=fix&review_id=5730800567) ｜ [Fix 👍s ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog-v2/4?action=fix-approved&review_id=5730800567) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog-v2/actions/runs/41362558494/job/125015843765) ｜ Using `claude-opus-5-5` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)
